_doc: v3 settings for the monsoon (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from monsoon_prep.json (work dir monsoon_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/monsoon_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: monsoon

source.title: Saracen, Scimitar, and Saladin Hovertanks
source.author: UnrestedGuy
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 6, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in monsoon_veh.json). Parts split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (monsoon_prep.json). Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 1.5 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no Blender collapse on shell soup). Own-geometry wheels (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) where there are wheels; they are part of the derivative. HOVER: no wheels or tracks. Kit: the Saracen hover chassis (`B-Saracen.stl`, baseless) with the Scimitar Standard turret (`Scimitar_Standard_Turret.stl`), as in the approved v1 build: MC2's Monsoon is a 25 t hover tank with one turret and short flamers, and the Scimitar chassis-and-turret pair is the closest of the three variants in the set (Saracen, Scimitar, Saladin); the turret's long main gun is left off (as in v1). The original's two engine nodes (`Engine1`, `Engine02`) are merged into the hull (the kit's side nacelles are static). The turret `Monsoon_Turret` turns about its neck ring.
